title: Apple TV welcomes back Ted Lasso with a clever new commercial - 9to5Mac
summary: The Apple TV streaming service launched a new commercial this week alongside the premiere of Ted Lasso season four. Season four of Ted Lasso is rolling out weekly with new episodes every Wednesday through October 7.
